quantization.rationale: System has 15.7GB RAM; F16 14B models need ~20GB. Industry-standard Q4_K_M quantization yields <2% quality loss with 3.3x size reduction.

bge_m3_safetensors.rationale: sentence-transformers requires torch>=2.6 for pytorch_model.bin due to CVE-2025-32434; our torch 2.5.1 is the max cu121 wheel. Conversion to safetensors bypasses this.

snowflake_torch_backend.rationale: Default loading tries ONNX variants that hang on Windows; explicit backend=torch forces safe path.
